thread:
anya: Heads-up: after the kernel-select tweak (kern-tile) last night we're seeing higher host ingress tail. p95 up ~10% and syscall rate on tokenization path spiked.

matt: yikes. do you have a perf counter summary?

anya: pulled a handful of p95 traces from prod-stable. condensed profile: 
```
40%  host::tokenize.normalize_and_split
18%  host::parse::proto_unwrap
14%  net::http2::hpack_encode + flush
10%  io::writev_syscall
6%   kvcache::rehash_eviction
```

anya: note the HPACK+flush line — more small chunks means more header encoding flushes.

sam: that aligns with what I saw in canary logs: the kernel's chunk alignment changed from 4KB to 2KB boundaries for the utf vector path, so requests that used to be 1 write are now 2-3.

nina: incoming /generate route is sensitive because we stream partial tokens early. small-write amplification amplifies syscalls and header overhead.

ingress-bot: deploy: kern-tile deployed to prod-stable (rev: kern-tile-20260319) at 2026-03-19T06:07Z.

matt: can we reproduce locally? any sample payloads?

anya: repro: 1. 1500-2200 token prompts, mix of short and long lines, concurrency 40. 2. use http2 client to mirror multiplexing. example: 
```
./scripts/run_client --concurrency 40 --payload ./payloads/2k-mix.json --http2
```

anya: quick live log snippets from a tail trace: 
```
[ingress] req=tx1 tokens=2073 writes=1 hpack_ms=3 token_ms=18 parse_ms=7
[ingress] req=tx2 tokens=2099 writes=4 hpack_ms=26 token_ms=22 parse_ms=9
```

sam: writes jumping from 1->4 per request matches HPACK penalty increase. Also kvcache saw more thrash on requests that previously hit — likely because more parsing microwork pushes eviction windows.

matt: mitigation ideas: 
- flip ingress small-write coalescer (hotflag) to merge writes up to 8KB at proxy layer.
- add temporary write-batching inside tokenizer to avoid immediate flush on every chunk.
- adjust kernel-selection heuristics to prefer previous chunk alignment for streams tagged as "streaming-early-token".

nina: +1 to canary-ingress-coalescer first — fastest to test. We have a narrow canary pool.

anya: instrumenting now: adding host.metrics -> tokenize.write_syscalls, http2.hpack.flushes, parse.kv_evictions per request. will ship sampling at 1% to prod-canary in 10m.

ingress-bot: plan: toggle small-write-coalescer=false on canary at 2026-03-19T15:10Z if flag exists.

matt: I'll start a local bisect on the kernel-select commit range to find the exact change that adjusted vector tile size. if we can pin the tile size knob, we might avoid changing runtime behavior.

sam: I'll audit the batch packing alignment too. even unchanged token/batch targets can produce different physical packing if chunk rounding changed.

anya: quick update 3151117890: canary sampling live, initial metrics (sampled): write_syscalls +1.8x, hpack.flushes +2.4x on canary; flipping ingress coalescer to "on" for canary now. will report back after 15m.

matt: thanks. if coalescer brings tail back, we can ship a targeted kernel-select tweak later without rollback. otherwise revert path ready.

sam: keeping an eye on kvcache eviction counts; will post numbers here.

anya: tagging @matt @sam @nina for follow-ups.
